question: The desktop background is also known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wallpaper**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The desktop background is commonly referred to as **Wallpaper**, which is an image or pattern displayed on the computer screen behind icons and open windows.
 
• Wallpapers can be customized according to user preferences and are supported by most operating systems, including **Windows, macOS, and Linux.**
 
• The term “wallpaper” originates from the idea of decorating a virtual space similar to physical wallpaper used in homes.
 
• Wallpapers can be static images or dynamic (moving) wallpapers, depending on the system capabilities and software used.
 
• Users can select wallpapers from the system's default options or upload their own images to personalize the desktop environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Icon:** Icons are small graphical representations of programs, files, or functions on a computer desktop, used to facilitate easy access.
 
• **Menu:** Menus are graphical elements or lists that provide access to various commands or options within a software or operating system.
 
• **File:** Files are digital containers that store data, such as text documents, images, videos, or software applications.
 
• **Dynamic Wallpapers:** These are animated or interactive wallpapers that change over time or react to user interactions.
 
• **Desktop Environment:** The desktop environment is the graphical interface through which users interact with their operating system, including elements like wallpapers, icons, menus, and taskbars.
